evaluation.uncertainty: resample complete UTC game dates for paired 95% intervals
evaluation.promotion_gate: Freeze code/config/source receipts; evaluate untouched later data once; require paired Brier improvement with upper95% delta below zero versus all three baselines, nonworsening log loss, calibration review and explicit model-promotion approval. limitations: Six algorithms share inputs and upstream feeds; agreement is not independent confirmation or calibrated confidence.
